kenbuild-20241213.relevance: Build engine snapshots 1993-1996. BUIL0422: ENGINE.C+ENGINE.OBJ pair (compiler calibration). buildsrc-20190520.relevance: 1995-1997 engine objects/sources (SRC_9505 A.OBJ/ENGINE.OBJ). Later than the target.

lameduke.relevance: Original 1997 distribution; D3D.EXE identical to oracle; file timestamps.

watcom95_c32_a.relevance: Watcom 9.5 32-bit patch kit (a 1993-09, b 1994-01, c 1994-06-30). Library patches are OMF libraries of replacement members; executables use WATCOM binary patch format (BPATCH).

watcom95_c32_b.relevance: Watcom 9.5 32-bit patch kit (a 1993-09, b 1994-01, c 1994-06-30). Library patches are OMF libraries of replacement members; executables use WATCOM binary patch format (BPATCH).

watcom95_c32_c.relevance: Watcom 9.5 32-bit patch kit (a 1993-09, b 1994-01, c 1994-06-30). Library patches are OMF libraries of replacement members; executables use WATCOM binary patch format (BPATCH).

duke3d-1.3d.license: mixed, see its LICENSE.md (GPL game code, BUILDLIC engine)
duke3d-1.3d.relevance: Byte-identical Duke3D v1.3D reconstruction (Watcom 10.0, 1996). Infrastructure and research reference; code is ~1 year later than the target.

dukenukem3d.relevance: Duke3D 1.5 released source: semantic reference for game code names and logic.

audiolib-reconstructions.relevance: Apogee Sound System 1.04-1.12 reconstructions + original LIBs. ASS 1.04 AUDIO_WF.LIB gives 337 exact function hits in the target.

rayman_recon.relevance: Watcom matching infrastructure; tools/omf.py, match.py, libscan.py, wcc.py adapted here.

leads.tekwar_witchaven: Les Bird Capstone dev snapshots (archive.org tekwar_source, WHAVEN): Build ENGINE.OBJ 1995-07, A.OBJ 1995-06, built with Watcom 9.5 per author; Witchaven GAME.OBJ 1995-03, BUILD.TXT 1995-09.
leads.rott_shareware_1_0: ROTT 1.0 shareware 1994-12-21 (classicdosgames 1rott.zip): Apogee Sound System binary 9 days before LameDuke.
leads.sw_prototypes: Shadow Warrior 1995-01-15 / 02-10 prototypes (Steam Shadow Warrior Classic extras): post-LameDuke engine binaries, map v6; unverified.
